details.detail: Overall massing and layout: the 1.30 m shell, 2.20 m pitch, aisle-side wardrobe, window console, pier, lowered centre divider and the 0.63 centre seat are unchanged and still match the real photos. The narrow centre suite is known and not scored.

Centre-screen fins: FIXED from an X to a V. The yaw is now +18 deg, so each aft end stays in its own suite, and the taupe cap is gone. Two faults remain. The forward ends sit 0.02 off the divider, so a 0.04+ slot opens at the apex. From the aisle (q02 x 410-490) the pair reads as two cabinet doors standing ajar. Real f4 (1D/1G from aft) shows what looks like ONE panel between the screens, with a thin light top edge. f5 may show one per suite. Single versus pair is unresolved.

Forward aisle hood: IMPROVED. It is now one flat-topped 0.172 x 0.09 x 0.66 arm, top flush at H+0.0625 and overhanging 0.03 forward, and it has no collision with the row ahead (0.04 gap). From the aisle (q02 crop) it reads as a continuous thick corner arm, close to f4. From inside (q03 x 690-840 y 85-135, q05 x 590-650) it still reads as a separate rounded bolster: its underside hangs 0.03 below the adjoining caps, its rounded inboard end pokes out over the pier, and its lit underside is lighter than the screen-wall cap. In f10 the inside corner top is a flat, thin taupe sweep. In f4 the real prow also overhangs further forward and out over the aisle (roughly 0.08-0.10).

Headrest flap: FIXED. It is now neutral: seat_front flap 86/87/83 against back 73/67/61, 1.19x the back (f9: 147/148/143 against 126/119/111, 1.17x). It no longer reads blue or glassy. A thin lighter border still frames it (f9 has a plain folded fabric edge).
Reading spots: FIXED. They are now about 0.074 across, at seatX ± (SW/2+0.01) in the header corners, matching f9 and f5 in size and position.
Seat niche: FIXED. The jambs and header are now fConsole. seat_front header 91/85/81 against back 73/67/61 (1.24x; f9 1.19x with a warmer header 150/136/117), so the niche outline now reads.

Lilac pillow (seat mode): FIXED outline. It is now a rectangular 0.45 x 0.30 plump loft with no octagon (seat_front, c_front). It lacks f9's pinched 'ear' corners and the diamond/zig-zag jacquard, so it reads a little like a smooth foam block. The render colour 120/109/179 is about 0.75x f9 (159/146/221), which is lighting-limited.

Seat cushion tone (studio): the seat pan renders 183/172/160, 2.5x the back, and reads beige. In f9 the cushion (117/108/103) is slightly DARKER than the back. It uses the same fFabric, so this is the studio top light, not the material. Mention only.

Window-suite screen wall: PARTLY fixed. The wing is 0.08 (0.068 of visible wood) and the pier is now at 60 deg, about 0.22 wide. Because the pier now turns 60 deg away from the screen plane, its projected width from the seat is only about 0.11 (w_screen: a narrow strip beside the screen). In f10 the pier projects about 0.28 (180 px against the 605 px screen) and is only moderately angled. The mirror pill tone is right (q03 69/79/97 against f10 90/102/127, both blue-grey). The wing still has no visible large-radius upper outer corner with a taupe edge (f10 right, f49). The pier wood renders near-black (35/31/30) against f10's 98/96/98, which is partly lighting.
Window console, tray, keypad, handset and ottoman: unchanged and good.

Aisle door leaves: now 15 ribs per leaf at 0.026 pitch (known and deliberate; real ~22). The studio w_aisle is now clean, with no wavy moire. At cabin distance the grazing leaves in q02 (x 740-900) still break into a herringbone or woven texture, though weaker than in w3.

Bed mode: the lavender pillow is FIXED, lying low in front of the propped white pillow (q04, bed.png), as in f46. The duvet is still NOT fixed (my w3a issue): in q04 and bed.png the bed is one bare white slab with no fold, edge or duvet separation. Sun stripes wash it further (lighting).

Seat plaque: the position is right. It still renders as a dark inset tile with white text (q02 '2G', q04 '1A'). The white text is known and pending the integrator. The dark tile background also comes from the glyph quad.

issues.problem: The centre fins read as two cabinet doors standing ajar, with a slot at the apex
issues.detail: 09d_suite.js centre branch: fin = M4.trs(-hx + 0.02, 0, -L + 0.15, 18*DEG). The mirrored pair leaves a gap of at least 0.04 m (plus the divider) at the forward ends, and both 0.28-deep dark boards are fully visible from the aisle.
issues.evidence: q02_suiteAisle.png x 410-490 y 130-320: two separated dark boards splayed apart like open doors. omaat_f4 (1D/1G from aft): what reads as one panel between the screens. omaat_f3: the fin has a thin lit top edge.
issues.fix: Start each fin at x = -hx + 0.011 (half the 0.02 thickness), so the two forward edges touch at the divider line and form a closed V. Optionally add a 0.004 lighter fWood or fCap edge strip on top. If the user confirms there is a single panel per pair, build it only when !mir.

issues.problem: The window-suite pier is foreshortened to a sliver from the seat
issues.detail: pAng = 60 deg makes pw about 0.22, but it projects only about 0.11 onto the screen plane as seen from the seat.
issues.evidence: studio/w_screen.png and q03: a narrow pier strip beside the screen. omaat_f10: the pier projects about 0.28 m (180/605 of the 0.952 screen), a broad wood face holding the mirror and lamp.
issues.fix: Make the pier a two-facet face: a 0.10-0.12 coplanar flat (0 deg) flush with the screen edge, then the angled 60-deg return to the wardrobe. That gives about 0.2 of projected wood with the mirror centred on the flat or across the fold. If the width budget forbids it, reduce the bezel margin or the wing to 0.06.

issues.problem: The corner hood still reads as a bolster from inside the suite
issues.detail: gRBox(0.172, 0.09, 0.66, r 0.035) at H+0.0175: the bottom at H-0.0275 is 0.03 below the adjacent caps, and the rounded inboard end overhangs the pier top.
issues.evidence: q03 x 690-840 y 85-135 (zoom: a separate rounded roll above the pier lamp). q05 x 590-650: a knob over the corner. omaat_f10: a flat, thin taupe sweep over the pier from inside.
issues.fix: Split it: an inboard part (x < hx-0.10) at cap thickness 0.06 with square small-radius edges, flush with the pier-top cap, plus the 0.09-thick rounded prow only on the aisle half. Extend the prow about 0.06 forward and 0.03 out over the aisle, per f4.

issues.problem: The bed duvet is still invisible (carried over from w3a)
issues.detail: Duvet #e2dfd8 on pad #f0efea, full width, with no fold.
issues.evidence: q04 and studio/bed.png: one white slab. omaat_f46: a folded duvet on the window half with a visible folded edge and the sheet showing.
issues.fix: Make the duvet SW*0.55 wide, offset to the window side, with a 0.02 rounded fold edge and a warmer '#d9d4ca'.

issues.problem: The fluted leaves still alias at grazing angles in the cabin
issues.detail: 15 ribs per leaf is known and deliberate. The residual herringbone appears in q02 only.
issues.evidence: q02 x 740-900 y 180-480 at 3x zoom: a woven chevron texture.
issues.fix: Use a far LOD (flat leaf plus a mipmapped groove texture) beyond about 3 m, or leave it as accepted.

issues.problem: The seat pillow has no jacquard and no pinched corners
issues.evidence: omaat_f9 and f22: a diamond or zig-zag woven pattern and thin 'ear' corners.
issues.fix: If a shared diamond layer exists, apply it at low gain. Pinch the corner sections to thickness 0.01 in the first and last SEC only at the ends.

issues.detail: The plaque is a dark tile with white text, pending the integrator. In the studio the seat pan renders beige (2.5x the back) where f9 has it slightly darker than the back. In the cabin, sun stripes wash out the bed and the ottoman, and the pier and fin wood render near-black against f10's mid-grey wood.
issues.evidence: q02 '2G', q04 '1A'; seat_front cushion 183/172/160 against f9 117/108/103; q04 sun stripes.

questionsForUser: Centre suites: is there ONE angled wood fin between the D and G screens (omaat_f4 suggests one), or one fin per suite forming a V (the current model)?
